records.text: Emma Goldman was behind Margaret Sanger and Planned Parenthood.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She was also the woman that was behind Margaret Sanger, Planned Parenthood. Emma's boyfriend, also from the Pale of Settlement, tried to assassinate Henry Frick of the U.S. steel.

verification.notes: Goldman was an early mentor and birth-control influence on Sanger, but Sanger organized the bodies that became Planned Parenthood. The vague claim that Goldman was behind Planned Parenthood overstates her institutional role.

sources.title: Pioneers in Family Planning: Margaret Sanger, Rose Pastor Stokes, and Emma Goldman | Yale
sources.relevance: Describes Goldman's mentorship and Sanger's organizational role.

sources.title: Margaret Sanger and Birth Control | University of Michigan
sources.relevance: Documents Sanger's creation of the organization that became Planned Parenthood.
